title: Hospital Authority blood-culture non-susceptibility
provider: Centre for Health Protection / Hospital Authority, Hong Kong SAR Government
citation: Centre for Health Protection. Hospital Authority AMR Data (2024): Blood key findings. Released 30 January 2026.
observation_grain: Year × organism × antimicrobial × onset setting, blood culture

terms.attribution: Source: Centre for Health Protection / Hospital Authority, Hong Kong SAR Government. Source rights remain with the Government and other owners.
terms.distribution_scope: Structured factual statistics and provenance are extracted. The source PDF, figures, layout and explanatory prose are not redistributed; the application MIT licence does not cover source material.
terms.notice_scope: The CHP notice permits complete unmodified copies for personal/internal non-commercial use. It does not establish a general open-data licence for this adapted extract.

dictionary.record_id: Stable record key within this source layout: physical page, antimicrobial row and year.
dictionary.value_status: reported or reported_with_suppressed_count; the percentage can remain reported while its count is suppressed.
dictionary.trend_raw: Original row-level trend direction and p-value label; source Cochran-Armitage test, no new trend test performed.
dictionary.footnote_pages: Physical PDF pages containing the shared notes.
dictionary.organism: Organism heading in the source PDF.
dictionary.antimicrobial: Source antimicrobial label with line-break hyphens joined; no drug-class-to-molecule substitutions.
dictionary.onset_setting: Literal source stratum: Community or Hospital.
dictionary.metric_definition: Official non-susceptibility percentage; retained separately from PHLSB R-only resistance.
dictionary.reported_percentage_operator: = for a reported number; <, >, ≤ or ≥ if shown.
dictionary.ci_lower: Source lower 95% CI boundary in percentage points; read with ci_lower_operator.
dictionary.ci_upper: Source upper 95% CI boundary in percentage points; read with ci_upper_operator.
dictionary.ci_lower_operator: Inequality symbol retained for a censored lower limit; = otherwise.
dictionary.ci_upper_operator: Inequality symbol for upper boundary; = otherwise.
dictionary.reported_numerator: Rounded reported patient numerator, or null when § suppressed.
dictionary.reported_denominator: Rounded reported AST denominator, or null when § suppressed.
dictionary.reported_total_headcount: Separate organism-specific annual total in the table header. This is not the AST denominator.
dictionary.ast_coverage_flag: lt70pct when †† is printed; not_flagged otherwise.
dictionary.breakpoint_note: Source breakpoint-change context; no retrospective reinterpretation.
dictionary.source_column: 1-based surveillance-year column (excluding label and onset columns).
dictionary.source_bbox: PDF cell bounding box (x0, top, x1, bottom), coordinates in points, stored as JSON text.
dictionary.raw_cell: Three source text lines: percentage, CI and numerator/denominator.
dictionary.raw_antimicrobial: Source antimicrobial text retaining line breaks.
dictionary.source_sha256: SHA256 of the complete source PDF.
dictionary.source_version: Report year, generation month and PDF SHA prefix.

notes.rounding: Patient headcounts are rounded to the nearest 100. Percentages and confidence limits are retained at source precision; they are not recalculated from rounded counts.
notes.suppression: The source symbol § identifies a positive patient count below 50; its numeric field is null and its literal symbol is retained.
notes.coverage: A †† suffix marks AST coverage below 70%. Absence of the suffix is stored as not_flagged, without estimating an exact testing percentage.
notes.deduplication: The source de-duplicates with location of onset considered. A patient can contribute an isolate to each onset group when available.
notes.confidence_intervals: The source reports Wilson 95% confidence intervals. An inequality at a confidence bound is stored separately from the numeric boundary.
notes.small_denominator: The report excludes non-susceptibility percentages based on fewer than 10 de-duplicated isolates. No result rows are invented for absent cells.
notes.metric: The metric remains the official non-susceptibility percentage. The checked key-findings PDF does not separately enumerate R and I categories; no R-only or I+R relabelling is imposed.
notes.scope: This PDF supplies E. coli hospital-onset records and K. pneumoniae community- and hospital-onset records. E. coli community-onset rows are not present in this file.

audit.excluded_scope: Pages 1–2 contain culture sampling/positivity statistics, not antimicrobial non-susceptibility. No rows added for groups not printed.
